notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one presses R2 on the 6807 and S1 on the C-502 strake (opening it tangentially), while C1 keeps the reference's 29.0 round the C-504 tube. The faces are bonded to the other half and to the strakes' ends, which take no clearance. The dimensions and fits are in 410-001_AxisIntersectionHalf.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
